name: labs/scaxlibur__wavebench
title: RIGOL DG4202 signal source (WaveBench dg4202 driver)
intro: RIGOL DG4202 signal source (WaveBench dg4202 driver), adapted from scaxlibur/wavebench. It reads `identity` and `amplitude_unit`; sets `output`, `function`, `frequency`, `amplitude` and 1 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/scaxlibur__wavebench --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/scaxlibur__wavebench --backend fake --mcp
